title: Stock page: a cylinder stock always faces Z; the yaw field cannot tilt it

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Reported by the maintainer in chat on 2026-11-18:

> when setting up stock using a cylinder you can't change the direction that the cylinder faces. it is along Z. i want it along X or Y or anything in between. there is a "rotation" but i can't seem to figure out what it does.

What happens:

- On the Stock page, the user picks Cylinder stock. The cylinder's axis always stands along Z.
- The page has one rotation field: "Rotation (yaw deg)". Changing it does nothing visible for a cylinder.

What the code does today:

- `StockShape::Cylinder { diameter, height }` in `crates/geometry/src/geometry/stock.rs` builds the mesh along Z. The shape has no axis or direction field.
- The Stock page sends its rotation as a yaw-only quaternion (`quat_from_yaw` in `crates/ui/src/state.rs`). Yaw turns about Z. A cylinder is round about Z, so the field changes nothing for a cylinder. It turns a Box only.
- `SetStock` stores a full rotation quaternion in the stock's `Location`, so the document and the project file can already hold a tilted stock. Only the UI and the meshing follow Z.

Expected:

- The user can set the cylinder's axis to X, to Y, or to any direction between.
- The rotation field does what its label says, or its label says what it does.

Possible workaround today:

- Put a cylinder model in the document, rotate it with MoveModel, and take the stock "From model". This does not help every path: the simulation's field view refuses a stock that carries a rotation (see #2177).

What the work must decide:

- The controls: three axis angles (yaw, pitch, roll) on the Stock page, or an axis picker (Z / X / Y / custom).
- What the field view and the collision checks do with a tilted cylinder stock (#2177 closed one case of this refusal; a tilted primitive needs the same review).
- Wording: rename or explain the current "Rotation (yaw deg)" field.
